meta.source: GBIF occurrence search (api.gbif.org/v1/occurrence/search), all datasets; iNaturalist research-grade observations dominate
meta.boxNote: a box of +/- boxHalfKm of latitude and of longitude (scaled by cos latitude) around the town: about 100 km square
meta.dataPoorRule: a town is dataPoor when GBIF holds fewer than dataPoorBelow plant + fungi records (kingdomKey 6, 5) in its box with the same filters
meta.speciesMap: per town, the library species admitted there by region, country and box rules with at least one record in the box: n records, byMonth = records by calendar month (Jan..Dec). A species admitted there but not listed has no record in the box. nearestKm is not collected.
